“orchestrator” wants to run in the background
Module: orchestrator@/usr/lib/contour/extensions/orchestrator.wasm
Directory (worktrees, created if missing): /home/u/worktrees
Directory (repos): /home/u/repo/contour
It may run only these, which can reach the network as you:
gh-auth (short, in repos): gh auth status
gh-default-branch (short, in repos): gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef
gh-prs (long, in repos): gh pr list --author @me --state open --limit 100 --json number,title,url,headRefName,baseRefName,isDraft,isCrossRepository,reviewDecision,statusCheckRollup,closingIssuesReferences --jq [.[]|[.number,.title,.url,.headRefName,.baseRefName,.isDraft,.isCrossRepository,.reviewDecision,[.closingIssuesReferences[]|[.number,.url]],[.statusCheckRollup[]|[.__typename,.name,.context,.status,.conclusion,.state]]]]
gh-issues (long, in repos): gh issue list --state open --limit 100 --search {query} --json number,title,url
git-fetch (long, in repos): git fetch --quiet {remote}
git-worktree-add (long, in repos): git worktree add --detach {path} {base}
git-worktree-add-branch (long, in repos): git worktree add --no-track -b {branch} {path} {base}
git-worktree-list (short, in repos): git worktree list --porcelain -z
gh-pr-checkout (long, in worktrees): gh pr checkout {number} --branch {branch}
git-common-dir (short, in worktrees): git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir
git-status (short, in worktrees): git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal --ignore-submodules=none
git-head-reachable (short, in worktrees): git for-each-ref --count=1 --contains HEAD refs/heads refs/tags refs/remotes
git-operation-state (short, in worktrees): git -c status.displayCommentPrefix=false -c color.status=false status --long
git-index-flags (short, in worktrees): git ls-files -v --stage
git-clean (short, in worktrees): git clean -f -- STATUS.md
git-worktree-remove (long, in worktrees): git worktree remove {path}
agent-setup-check (short, in worktrees): contour agent setup --dry-run --json
It may open tabs running: agent (in worktrees): claude --model {model} --session-id {session} {prompt}
It may read files in: worktrees
It shows its own tab: orchestrator://
